description: Explains Microsoft authentication error codes from Microsoft's official tables: Entra ID sign-in errors (AADSTS50126, or the bare 50126), Windows NTSTATUS codes as logged in events 4625/4776 (0xC000006A, C000006A, or decimal 3221225578 / -1073741718), Kerberos failure codes from events 4768/4769/4771 (0x18), Win32 error codes such as the data value of an LDAP bind failure (data 52e, data 775) or System error 1326, and official names (IdsLocked, STATUS_ACCOUNT_LOCKED_OUT, KDC_ERR_PREAUTH_FAILED, ERROR_ACCOUNT_LOCKED_OUT). Paste a whole error message or event to find every code in it, or give words to search names and descriptions. Returns the official name and description, where the code is logged, and LogTriage's investigation page when one exists. Free; no API key needed.

query.description: A code, a pasted error or event, or words such as 'account locked'.

name: lookup_error_code
title: Look up a Windows, Entra ID or Kerberos error code
